description: Generate 3D content from text or images; these operations may cost credits.

identity.goal: Complete the generative 3d use case of blender using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the blender upstream of the blender-connector connector. The namespace `blender` is active by default; if the operator set lazy activation, activate it with registry_activate first. Every tool below is namespaced blender_<tool>. Call `handshake` first and stop with a recovery report when it is not ready. Save the .blend file before running code. Use this when: The user asks for a new textured model from a prompt or image, or for a generated environment as Gaussian splats. Do not use it for: Ordinary scene building, ground, rooms or backdrops you can model or find (use blender-build-scene or blender-assets). Do not generate repeats: duplicate the first object instead. Tools: `blender_get_addon_status`, `blender_generate_3d`, `blender_generate_gaussian_world`, `blender_get_scene_info`. Steps, each with one objective and a check you must pass before the next: (1) Confirm a generator is switched on and get the user's approval for the cost. Call `blender_get_addon_status`. Check: `generators` (or `worlds`) lists a provider as on, and the user has agreed to a billable generation. (2) Describe one object (or one world) and start the generation. Call `blender_generate_3d`. Check: Either the object is imported, or you receive a job handle. (3) If a job handle came back, call again with the job until it finishes. Call `blender_generate_3d`. Check: The object is imported; repeating a request whose job is unfinished resumes it rather than paying again. (4) Inspect the result and integrate it (scale, place, ground). Call `blender_get_scene_info`. Check: Size and orientation are plausible; fix with a `blender_execute_blender_code` step. On failure follow the recovery table of the skill `blender-generative-3d`; report a refusal payload when a tool refuses and never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the blender namespace was available and handshake was ready before the first tool call
every step's check passed before the next step ran
every tool named in this prompt exists in the upstream snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
